ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the image, there are three lines of text on the notice board, respectively: “All the eels are electric eels except 12”, “All the eels are moray eels except 14”, “All the eels are freshwater eels except 16”. That is to say, there are 12 eels that are not electric, 14 eels that are not moray, and 16 eels that are not freshwater. Then reason: the problem states that there are only three kinds of eels in the water tank: electric, moray, freshwater. Add the three quantities of “not a certain kind” together, obtaining 12 + 14 + 16 = 42. For any eel, it belongs to one of the three kinds, therefore it will be counted once each in the “except” quantities of the other two kinds, so each eel is counted twice in 42. Therefore the total number of eels is 42 ÷ 2 = 21.
